$comment: Obsidian Local REST API (with MCP) — the vault IS this repo, so this exposes the project's own notes,
docs, spec transcription and JSON SSOTs as MCP tools/resources.
⛔ NO SECRET LIVES IN THIS FILE. The bearer token is expanded from the environment at load time, because
`.claude/settings.local.json` is TRACKED in this repo and `.mcp.json` is excluded only by a machine-local
`.git/info/exclude` rule — neither is a safe home for a 64-char API key.
TWO ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES ARE REQUIRED, and `pwsh scripts/setup-obsidian-mcp.ps1` prints both:
OBSIDIAN_API_KEY     the plugin's key, read from its (gitignored) data.json
The API serves HTTPS with a SELF-SIGNED cert (CN=Obsidian Local REST API), so without the CA var Node
rejects the connection — verified: curl needs --cacert or -k, and returns 200 with it.
⚠ THIS SERVER IS OPTIONAL AND MUST STAY THAT WAY. It requires Obsidian to be RUNNING, so nothing in the
build, the gates or CI may depend on it — the compiler's generators must work headless. It is a
convenience for reading/searching the vault during a session, never a source of truth.
